Power 
 Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection list I1, which must be carried out 
every two months as indicated by M2 in the title 
block.

This Fan 
is used for heating combustion air to raise the efficiency of the boiler.

The first draft initiated by eng. Fawzy 
Ahmed Bsiouny, tested at 01 
Nov. 2003, 
reviewed by maintenance 
director: eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, 
accepted by maintenance general director eng. 
Ali 
Mostafa Al-lithy 
and approved by eng. 
Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of 
TALKHA power station.
Technical specification of the Fan
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear safety 
 helmet, and safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the re-circulation gas fan and its 
 lubrication system.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Feeler gauge.
Suitable lifting device.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Setting

rows: Check the Lubricating oil level in tank

items:
Check the front & rear bearing and 
 replace the defect bearing.

Open the manhole of fan and check 
 the impeller from corrosion or mechanical wear.

Check the clearance between the 
 impeller and fan casing.

Check the internal sealing and 
 changed it if needed.

Dismantle the safety cover of the 
 cooling disk.

Dismantle and check the cooling desk 
 of the rear &front bearing house.

Check the rear & front outside 
 sealing and exchanged it if needed.

Dismantle the safety cover of the 
 coupling.

Dismantle the coupling covers and 
 check the two half springs, exchange if it needed.

Check the alignment of the two 
 coupling half and re-alignment it if needed.
Re-grease the couplings springs.
Check and retighten all bolts.

Clean the oil cooler and check the 
 oil cooler fan.

Check the lubricating oil pump and 
 repair it if needed.

Check the oil level in the tank and 
 bearing house / or refill it if needed.

If you need any help please 
 look at the major maintenance procedure MPIS doc. no. Fan-002-r0

After successful 
 inspection, operate the fan again, read all the available record value and 
 putted in table (1) to compare between the values before and after inspection.
